item.title: Cult of the Lamb: Woolhaven (NS) Review | VGChartz
item.description: VGChartz's Evan Norris: "Woolhaven is proof that Massive Monster made the right decision to stick with Cult of the Lamb. By retaining everything the vanilla version does right, and adding several novelties a somber story about the Lamb's lost clan, two new dungeons filled with unexpected horrors, a wintry weather system that changes the rules of survival, and consequential ranching and rot mechanics the expansion takes what was already a great game and makes it even better.
